nodes.label: Normalized API Error Shape
nodes.rationale: Standardized safe error response hiding internal details, stack traces, and provider tokens.

nodes.label: Mock Instagram Mode
nodes.rationale: Allows UI and database development without live Meta credentials while keeping mock stubs behind the same service interface.

nodes.label: Claude Code Layer Rules
nodes.rationale: Enforces strict unidirectional flow UI -> server route -> ownership check -> service -> Prisma/Meta -> normalized response to avoid leaking secrets or bypassing security.

nodes.label: Multi-Account Isolation Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Always scope queries by userId to prevent cross-tenant account access.

nodes.label: Token Encryption at Rest Specification
nodes.rationale: Store tokens encrypted using AES-GCM via TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY to prevent credentials leakage.

nodes.label: No Scope Creep Constraint
nodes.rationale: Prevents implementing publishing, scheduling, teams, or billing during MVP.

nodes.label: Preserve Architecture Constraint
nodes.rationale: Prohibits moving provider logic to UI, skipping ownership checks, or introducing secondary ORMs.

nodes.label: Verify Provider Capabilities Constraint
nodes.rationale: Do not fabricate unsupported Meta metrics or features; mark them unavailable cleanly.

nodes.label: Database Ownership Verification Rule
nodes.rationale: Every query must include userId to prevent horizontal privilege escalation.

nodes.label: MVP Explicit Non-Goals
nodes.rationale: Defer microservices, billing, background workers, and scheduling to build a reliable minimal monolith first.

nodes.label: Cryptographic OAuth State Security
nodes.rationale: Cryptographically secure state prevents CSRF during Meta authorization callback.

nodes.label: User Ownership Authorization
nodes.rationale: All operations must enforce account belongs to authenticated user ID.

nodes.label: Safe Logging Policy
nodes.rationale: Never log access tokens, secrets, codes, or session data; log only correlation ID and error categories.

nodes.label: AES-GCM Token Encryption
nodes.rationale: Access tokens encrypted at rest via TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY and decrypted strictly in lib/security.

nodes.label: Official OAuth Only Rule
nodes.rationale: Ban username/password login and scraping to ensure compliance with Meta terms and platform security.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: Prevent regressions from stale agent training data on Next.js breaking changes and auto-generated marker files.

nodes.label: Server-Side Meta OAuth Flow
nodes.rationale: Tokens exchanged server-side only; state validated; never expose access token to browser.

nodes.label: Instagram Service Layer API
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates all Meta provider interactions behind internal service functions.

nodes.label: Database-Backed MVP Caching
nodes.rationale: Use simple database snapshots for media and insights rather than complex message queues for MVP.
